story: Sophie is at the pet store with her friend Mia. The pet store has big tanks and small tanks. Sophie sees three orange fish swimming in a small tank. [emotion:QT/surprised] One tiny fish is hiding under a rock! Sophie points to the rock. Mia looks under the rock and finds the tiny fish. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and Mia are so happy. They each pick a fish to watch. Sophie picks the tiny fish. The kind worker puts the fish in a round bag. Sophie is holding the bag with both hands.
